reason: The hypothesis relies on grain refinement to improve ductility while retaining strength, but none of the cited studies involve the HfZrTiTa0.53 alloy, refractory HEAs, or thermomechanical processing of such alloys. E1 and E3 show grain refinement benefits in completely different alloy systems (CoCrNiV and AlCoCrFeNi2.1), and E2 concerns cryogenic properties of a medium-entropy alloy, providing no direct support for the key premises in this refractory HEA context.
